The '''Kamar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]].
